highlights.title: Blocked bots show under Needs you
highlights.text: When a bot working on its own ends its reply with a Blocked line, the thing only you can do now shows under Needs you in the Inbox, with a reminder a day later. It clears when you write back.

highlights.title: Search opens the right thread
highlights.text: Search finds your messages inside a bot's threads and groups them under the thread's title. Click one and that thread opens with the message highlighted, instead of an error that the chat is gone.

highlights.title: Typing stays quick in long chats
highlights.text: In a chat with hundreds of messages, each key used to redraw every message above it. Now only the box you type in changes, so letters show up as fast as in a new chat.

highlights.title: See who is working at a glance
highlights.text: On a computer, a Working block now sits right under Needs you in the sidebar. It shows up to 3 busy bots and a link to the rest, so you no longer scroll the list to find them.

highlights.title: Long chats load their earlier messages
highlights.text: A long chat used to stop at its newest 100 messages. Now scrolling up loads the earlier ones and keeps your place, and a line shows where the chat starts.

highlights.title: Scripts that send things out ask first
highlights.text: In Ask only when risky, a bot's script given an email address or a web address now asks you first, the way curl already did. Addresses on this computer still run.

fixes: Done while you were away shows a finished answer's tables and lists formatted, and a one-bot job shows the bot's name instead of "1 bot".
Search lists the thread whose title matches what you typed first, and Enter opens it.
Stopping one teammate while others finish no longer makes the lead report back twice.
A project script started with npm, uv, cargo or make now asks before it is given an email or web address.
After a restart mid-reply, the note says the cut-off step in plain words, like "running a command", not a tool id.
The app, phone alerts and Telegram name a step the same way; built-in Write and Edit read as writing or changing a file.
